Analytical N=2 limits: c_2=sqrt(D/2)/k and V_2=3D/(4k)
correctness.rationale: For every fixed integer N>=2 and k,D,r>0, exact OU Gaussian propagators yield iid affine coefficients A=exp(-kE/r), B=sqrt(D(1-A^2)/k) times the maximum of N unit Gaussians. E log A=-k/r<0 proves existence and uniqueness of the stationary perpetuity. Beta integrals reconstruct its exact mean and variance; rescaling centered innovations produces H=sqrt(2DE)M_N-kc_N E with mean zero and variance 2D(nu_N-pi*mu_N^2/4). Predictable martingale quadratic variation converges to this variance/(2k), uniformly bounded fourth moments give Lindeberg, and the perpetuity tail is exponentially small in an index cutoff proportional to r. The stationary age is exponential and particle departures from the last reset coordinate are O_P(r^-1/2), yielding the diagonal Gaussian law. N=2 identities and 52 independent finite checks in verify_group_reset.py were replayed. The proof does not use finite testing as a substitute for an infinite limit.
residual_risks: No quantitative convergence rate established; the stated limit is fixed-N and does not imply large deviations.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison with the 2024/2026 foundational rightmost-selection model identifies a renewal kernel and stationary means/SCV but no fixed-N high-rate Gaussian law with its Poisson clock correction. The April 2026 continuation addresses absorbing hitting times. A further February 2026 diffusion-approximation article considers partial proportional resetting of order r^-1, not collective maximum resets with increments of order r^-1/2 and a diverging stationary center. Distinct fixed-origin reset gases and historical-maximum resetting do not imply the exact coefficient. Relevant indexed research results and accessible earlier scientific claims did not cover the statement; this is a best-knowledge novelty judgment, not a mathematical uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible earlier study of the same rightmost selection recurrence might already state the same high-rate Gaussian law.
The April 2026 source has an absorbing variant; the proved law is only the unabsorbed stationary reference, not a direct result about rare first-passage probabilities.
Generic martingale convergence theory is prior methodology; originality is confined to model-specific normalization, clock variance and joint particle limit.

RESULT.md gives exact limiting distribution, variance decomposition and whole-group convergence
value.rationale: Extreme-value group resetting was developed for biological selection and avoidance, and its initiating papers expressly show that detailed stationary spatial distributions matter beyond average positions or scaled variances. The result supplies the full and fixed-size high-frequency central law of precisely that stationary reference, with explicit order-statistic integrals, a nonvanishing variance and quantiles. It isolates a positive Poisson-clock variance contribution invisible to fixed-duration replacement, and establishes that the entire reset group shares a single asymptotic Gaussian displacement. The natural N=2 example has the exact variance 3D/(4k). This is a motivated classification of fluctuations, not an arbitrary numerical parameter point.
residual_risks: Gaussian central approximation alone cannot yield exponentially small fixed-boundary avoidance probabilities or a first-passage time theorem.
